text_block_list.text:
While walking around the academy, Symboli 
Rudolf spotted me and came over.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Good timing. There's something I wanted to 
consult you about regarding what comes 
next.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A matter has come up in the student 
council that requires a bit of time and 
manpower, you see.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I apologize, but I would like to dedicate 
the time we had scheduled for training 
today to handling this.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"I will definitely settle this today, so 
it won't affect tomorrow's training or—"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hoooold on a second--!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Teio?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Let me help you with your work, Prez! You 
need an extra pair of hands, right?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"While you say that... this is a Student 
Council matter, you see."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I want to help the President when she's in 
trouble too~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"I won't do anything unnecessary, and I'll 
do whatever the President says~ So 
please~?"
choice_data_list: It might be faster if you get some help.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun is right. If I step in, we'll 
have more than enough hands.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
No way~! And after all the work put into 
'Operation: Praise Good Little Kids'~~……

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Jeez! You'd better definitely let me help 
next time!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I'll take the thought for the deed.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Teio.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Trainer. Excuse me, but I must 
head to the student council.

True to her word, Symboli Rudolf tore 
through the work with furious momentum, 
wrapping it all up today.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Come on~! That's what they're saying! So 
can we~?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
We'll definitely have time for training 
too! The harder I work, the less work 
there'll be, so it'll totally be fine~~!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, to think you'd side with Teio, 
Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Teio. If we're doing this, you have to 
do exactly as I say.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay! Tell me, tell me! I wanna hear all 
about it~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"And on top of that, I'll get praised a 
ton by the President...♪"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Well then, Trainer. Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~♪ Lending a ha~nd♪

Symboli Rudolf managed to wrap up all the 
student council work within that single 
day.

Tokai Teio obediently listening played a 
big part in this, seeming to lighten 
Symboli Rudolf's burden somewhat.
